# Beacon

Beacon is a read-only skill that suggests the next owner for a stalled support ticket based on the handoff note you supply. It takes no external actions.

## Install

```sh
axm install @example/skills/beacon
```

Try it locally

> Beacon, who should own this stalled ticket next? Here’s the handoff note: “The customer was charged twice. Support confirmed both charges. Billing Operations handles refunds and is waiting for the charge IDs. I’ve added both IDs to the ticket.”

**Suggested owner:** Billing Operations. Support confirmed the duplicate charge and supplied the IDs Billing Operations needs to review the refund.

# Beacon

Beacon suggests who should own a stalled support ticket next, based on the handoff note you provide. The skill is read-only. You decide whether to reassign the ticket.

## Install

```sh
axm install @example/skills/beacon
```

Try it locally

> Beacon, who should own this stalled ticket next? Handoff note: “The customer reports two charges for one order. Support confirmed there’s only one order. Billing has access to the payment records needed to check the second charge.”

**Suggested next owner:** Billing. Support has confirmed the order count, and Billing can check whether the second charge went through.
